shots.focal_element: Archival 2012 Ahrefs homepage screenshot framed as a floating card above a '2012' timeline label and tick
on_screen_text: The largest index of live links
shots.typography: Outgoing AI-platform chips in a light sans, sentence case; archival page shows its own period web fonts (small, not quoted beyond the headline); year label is a clean white geometric sans, regular-to-medium weight, normal tracking, centred above a thin tick on a horizontal rule.
shots.what_happens: On VO 'We're not new to this' (w383-w387) the previous chip layout is pushed off as a heavily motion-blurred screenshot rises from below and settles centre; the 2012 Ahrefs homepage sits on the blue-to-peach gradient with the next year's screenshot peeking in at the right edge, and a timeline with '2012' appears at the bottom.
shots.build_rebuild: Tween a 16:9 screenshot card from y:+60% to centre over ~0.4s with a vertical motion-blur filter, fading the previous chips out upward, then fade in a centred year label above a 1px tick on a full-width horizontal rule.

shots.focal_element: 2013 Ahrefs 'Site Explorer & Backlink Checker' homepage card in a horizontal screenshot carousel with the '2013' year label
shots.typography: Archival page text in its original web fonts (headline in a light sans, pricing tiers in white on coloured bars); the overlaid year label is the same white geometric sans, medium weight, normal tracking; the outgoing year slides left and dims as the new year slides into centre.
shots.what_happens: The carousel slides left with horizontal motion blur: the 2012 card exits left (still partly visible), the 2013 homepage card lands centre and the bottom year ticker scrolls '2012' out and '2013' in under the fixed centre tick, while VO says 'Ahrefs pioneered the SEO' (w388-w391).
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out year screenshots in a horizontal row with ~6% gaps; on each beat translate the row left by one card width (~0.35s, strong ease-out, horizontal blur during travel) and scroll a synced year ticker beneath so the active year sits on the centre tick at full opacity and neighbours fade.

shots.focal_element: 2014 Ahrefs homepage card (Site Explorer hero with magnified circular chart) above the '2014' year label
shots.typography: Archival page fonts (light sans headline, uppercase button label, script-style 'Or check out subscription options'); overlay year label unchanged: white geometric sans, medium weight, normal tracking, centred.
shots.what_happens: Same carousel move: the row slides one card left with motion blur, the 2014 homepage locks into centre with 2013 at the left edge and a dark 2015 page peeking at the right, and the ticker advances to '2014' as VO says 'industry since 2012' (w392-w394).
shots.build_rebuild: Repeat the carousel step: translateX the screenshot row by one card width with a ~0.35s ease-out and blur, and advance the year ticker so '2014' lands on the centre tick while the previous year fades to low opacity.

shots.focal_element: Current 2025 Ahrefs homepage card 'Finally, a platform built for the future of marketing' at the end of a fast year-by-year carousel
on_screen_text: With Ahrefs Enterprise, your team comes together to grow your web presence
Finally, a platform built for the future of marketing
shots.typography: Modern Ahrefs pages: bold white sans headlines in sentence case on black (Enterprise) and royal blue (homepage); orange and outlined buttons; year ticker in the same white geometric sans, intermediate years (2015 to 2022) only visible as motion-blurred smears.
shots.what_happens: The carousel accelerates: several years whip past as heavy horizontal blur (individual years 2015 to 2022 not legible at 2 fps), it decelerates through the black 2024 Enterprise page and settles on the blue 2025 homepage; in the final frame the card scales down slightly, all on VO 'Now as AI reshapes discovery, we're leading the charge again,' (w395-w404).
shots.build_rebuild: Animate the screenshot row and year ticker with one long translateX tween (~1.8s, ease-in-out with heavy blur at peak velocity) across 10+ cards so mid-years smear, landing on the newest card, then scale that card to ~0.9 over the last 0.3s.

shots.focal_element: Large '250M+' stat with 'Total monthly prompts' on the left beside a six-row table of AI platforms and monthly prompt counts on the right
shots.transition_other: Not visible at 2 fps: the previous card was scaling down and s031 is already fully composed at its first sampled frame; likely a quick scale/dissolve.
shots.typography: Hero stat in a very large bold geometric sans with tabular figures and a smaller-cap 'M+'; caption in a regular-weight sans, sentence case; table headers in a light small sans; pill rows pair a logo plus platform name (medium weight) with right-aligned tabular numbers in a separate dark pill. Font guess (low confidence): a geometric grotesk similar to Inter/Satoshi.
shots.what_happens: A static data card holds on the gradient while VO says 'with the largest prompt datasets' (w405-w409): the 250M+ total sits left, and the right table lists per-platform monthly prompt counts in rounded dark pills with platform logos; the layout shifts only slightly (a small reframe) across the shot; no count-up is visible in the sampled frames.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a two-column layout on the brand gradient: left a 160px bold stat '250M+' over a 28px caption, right six rows each made of a logo+label pill and a wider right-aligned number pill, staggered in from the right at ~60ms intervals.
